The transition from the cephalofoil to the main body lacks clear anatomical definition; it appears somewhat fused or indistinct rather than showing the distinct neck/shoulder region.
The light refraction patterns on the surface appear slightly repetitive and painterly, lacking the chaotic randomness of real water caustics.
